entries.text: OverlayLock has its own rainbow lock-screen icon, in the same style as SpectraWrite's.

Every option is listed by `overlay-lock --help`: block the keyboard or the mouse system-wide, end the lock after a timeout, ignore Alt+F4, cover only the monitor under the cursor, and step back after Ctrl+Alt+Del so Task Manager can be used.

OverlayLock covers every monitor with a plain screen and hides the cursor until you type the password you gave it on the command line, and it can show a centred message in the colours, size and font you choose.
